techs.name: Agriculture
techs.quote: 'Where tillage begins, other arts follow. The farmers therefore are the founders of human civilization.' - Daniel Webster

techs.name: Pottery
techs.quote: The development of fired clay containers and simple ceramic construction.

techs.name: Seasonal Knowledge
techs.quote: 'The year speaks, if we learn to listen.' - Traditional saying, attributed to the First Farmers

techs.name: Water Management
techs.quote: 'Water is life, but only when we learn where to put it.' - Traditional saying of the River Settlers

techs.name: Fiberworking
techs.quote: 'A single thread is weak. Woven together, they become strong.' - Traditional saying of the First Weavers

techs.name: Food Preservation
techs.quote: 'The harvest feeds us once. What we preserve feeds us through the winter.' - Old Farmer's Proverb
